name: Random StartPos
description: Switches to a random StartPos every N deaths.

enabled.name: Enable Random StartPos
enabled.description: Master toggle. When off, the mod does nothing.

deaths-until-switch.name: Deaths Until Switch
deaths-until-switch.description: How many deaths before the StartPos changes. 1 = switch on every death.

random-threshold.name: Randomize Death Count
random-threshold.description: Pick a random number of deaths between 'Deaths Until Switch' and 'Max Deaths' before each switch.

max-deaths.name: Max Deaths (Randomize)
max-deaths.description: Upper limit used when 'Randomize Death Count' is on.

mode.name: Switch Mode
mode.description: random = any StartPos. next = left to right. previous = right to left. ping-pong = bounce back and forth.

avoid-recent.name: Avoid Recent Picks
avoid-recent.description: Random mode: don't pick any of the last N StartPos again. 0 = allow repeats, 1 = never the same twice in a row.

excluded.name: Excluded StartPos
excluded.description: Numbers of StartPos to never pick, separated by commas (numbered left to right from 1). Example: 1,4

include-level-start.name: Include Level Start
include-level-start.description: Also allow the very beginning of the level as a possible spawn.

switch-on-complete.name: Switch On Level Complete
switch-on-complete.description: Also pick a new StartPos when you beat the level from a StartPos.

min-percent.name: Only Count Deaths After %
min-percent.description: Deaths before this level percentage don't count toward switching. 0 = count every death.

ignore-practice.name: Disable In Practice Mode
ignore-practice.description: Practice mode checkpoints override StartPos. Enable this to stop counting deaths while in practice mode.

clear-checkpoints.name: Clear Checkpoints On Switch
clear-checkpoints.description: In practice mode, checkpoints override StartPos. This removes them when a switch happens so the new StartPos actually applies.

show-notification.name: Show Notification
show-notification.description: Show a small popup telling you which StartPos was selected.

notification-duration.name: Notification Duration
notification-duration.description: How long the switch popup stays on screen (seconds).

play-sound.name: Play Sound On Switch
play-sound.description: Play a short sound when the StartPos changes.

sound.name: Switch Sound
sound.description: Which sound plays when the StartPos changes (needs 'Play Sound On Switch').

show-label.name: Show On-Screen Label
show-label.description: Show the current StartPos and deaths left until the next switch while playing.

show-total-deaths.name: Label: Show Total Deaths
show-total-deaths.description: Add a death counter for this play session to the label.
